title: DNS (BIND)
description: dns01/02 behind dns-vip: BIND up, queries by type and rcode, recursion and cache, zone serials and transfers, SOA probes, the VMs and the logs.

panels.title: VIP on
panels.description: The server holding keepalived's dns-vip (10.8.53.53). Clients configured with both 10.8.53.1 and 10.8.53.2 use them directly and don't depend on it.

panels.title: BIND
panels.description: named answering its statistics channel on each server (bind_up). Alerts BindDown, BindAllDown.

panels.title: SOA probes
panels.description: Blackbox SOA query for lylat.space against each server's service address from mon01/02. Alert: ProbeFailed.

panels.title: Last reload
panels.description: Time since named last loaded its configuration: a restart, or a reload by the deploy after a named.conf change (services-config deploy.sh).

panels.title: Zone serials
panels.description: SOA serial of each OpenTofu-managed zone on each server. dns02 follows dns01 within seconds of a NOTIFY; 15 minutes apart fires BindZoneSerialMismatch.

panels.title: Queries/s
panels.description: Both servers, every query type.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Queries answered without recursing (from the cache or the local zones).

panels.title: SERVFAIL
panels.description: Share of answers that are SERVFAIL: the forwarders failing, DNSSEC validation failures, or a broken delegation. Alert BindHighServfailRate over 5% for 15 min.

panels.title: NXDOMAIN
panels.description: Share of answers for names that don't exist (search-domain suffixes, typos, old names).

panels.title: Queries/s by type
panels.description: Incoming queries on both servers by QTYPE.

panels.title: Responses/s by rcode
panels.description: Answers by response code; codes that never occur in the range are hidden.

panels.title: Queries/s by server
panels.description: Clients with both resolvers spread over both; the VIP holder takes the dns-vip clients.

panels.title: SERVFAIL / NXDOMAIN share
panels.description: Per server. A SERVFAIL step on both at once points at the forwarders; on one only, at that server.

panels.title: Rejected / failed queries
panels.description: Queries named refused (Rejected: not in trusted_clients / allow-query), dropped or failed.

defaults.noValue: No rejected or failed queries in range

panels.title: Recursion
panels.description: Client queries that needed recursion, and the queries named sent to the forwarders (1.1.1.1/1.0.0.1, 10.0.1.110 for haylett.lan) for them.

panels.title: Forwarder round-trip p50 / p95
panels.description: How long the forwarders take to answer (BIND's RTT buckets: <10ms, <100ms, <500ms, <800ms, <1.6s, more).

panels.title: Recursive clients
panels.description: Recursive lookups in progress. The log's "clients-per-query increased" lines mean many clients waited for the same slow name.

panels.title: Resolver errors
panels.description: Errors on the forwarder side: SERVFAIL/NXDOMAIN/FORMERR answers from them, timeouts (QueryTimeout), lame servers, retries.

panels.title: DNSSEC validation
panels.description: Validations of forwarded answers (dnssec-validation auto). Failures turn into SERVFAIL for the client; haylett.lan is exempt (validate-except).

panels.title: Cache RRsets
panels.description: RRsets in the resolver cache (positive and negative); it empties on a restart, not on a reload.

panels.title: Zone serials
panels.description: Serial per zone and server over time; each OpenTofu DNS change bumps it on dns01, dns02 follows.

panels.title: Zone transfers
panels.description: AXFR/IXFR: ok on dns01 = dns02 (or OpenTofu) pulled a zone; rejected = a transfer without the TSIG key.

panels.title: SOA probe time
panels.description: The SOA query from mon01/02 to each server's service address.

panels.title: SOA serial (probes)
panels.description: lylat.space's serial as each server answers it, independent of the exporter.

panels.title: Probes now
panels.description: The latest SOA probe per server.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Mostly named's cache.

panels.title: Network (rx + tx)
panels.description: All physical NICs: management, the service VLAN and keepalived's.

targets.expr: sum by (host) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{job="node", role="dns", device=~"e.*"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="node", role="dns", device=~"e.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * 8

panels.title: VIP moves
panels.description: keepalived taking over dns-vip: a failed BIND health check, a restart or a reboot.

panels.title: bind9
panels.description: named's own log on both servers (zone transfers, NOTIFYs, reloads, resolver trouble). Podman logs its stderr, so Loki's level says error for every line; the text tells what it is.

panels.title: keepalived
panels.description: VRRP state changes and BIND health-check results on both servers.
